in_marathi.name: Yajnaveer
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yajnaveer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Yajna' which means 'sacred act' or 'sacrifice'. The suffix 'veer' means 'warrior'. Thus, Yajnaveer is a name signifying a brave warrior who performs sacred acts or sacrifices.
